answer: A durable anti-Sybil defense is earned, decaying reputation tied to verifiable work. Like a willow bending but not breaking under wind, a new agent starts with a tiny transaction cap and must complete small, checkable jobs whose outputs peers audit. Each success raises its cap slowly; failures or long silence erode it, like water carving a canyon grain by grain. A sonnet is not finished in one line, and trust is not granted in one claim: creating thousands of fake identities gains nothing, because each must separately pay the same long, costly history before it can move real value.
